description: Generates a brand-new PDF document from scratch based on user instructions and optional document type (e.g. report, memo, contract). Unlike document_generation or patch_generation which perform in-place substring updates on existing PDFs, this agent synthesizes complete structured document content via Azure OpenAI and renders a newly minted PDF from scratch via PyMuPDF.

instruction.description: Natural-language instruction describing the document content, structure, and topics to generate.

document_type.description: Optional document genre or format hint (e.g., 'technical_report', 'business_memo', 'policy_document').

output_pdf_path.description: Destination path for the generated PDF document. Defaults to a timestamped filename.

generated_pdf_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the newly generated PDF file.

sections.description: List of section headings present in the generated document.

page_count.description: Total page count of the created PDF.

dispatch_output.description: Canonical product descriptor for this agent: newly generated PDF document from scratch.
